## Which checkpoint should I download?

Use **Qwen/Qwen3-8B** and the publisher’s GGUF files. This checkpoint supports thinking and non-thinking modes. Keep that mode fixed when comparing results; thinking output uses tokens and time before the final answer.

## Can I use its full context window?

Qwen lists 32,768 native tokens and up to 131,072 with YaRN. Extended context needs explicit runtime support and more memory. The Finder’s 64K planning limit does not verify YaRN support. See [[guides/context-length|context length]].

## What if it loads but runs out of memory?

Close other GPU workloads and reduce context. If needed, use a smaller file or partial CPU offload. For Macs or CPU-only setups, select the appropriate mode in the Finder; installed RAM is not dedicated VRAM.

Use **Qwen/Qwen3-8B** and the publisher’s GGUF files. This checkpoint supports thinking and non-thinking modes. Keep that mode fixed when comparing results; thinking output uses tokens and time before the final answer.

## Can I use its full context window?

Qwen lists 32,768 native tokens and up to 131,072 with YaRN. Extended context needs explicit runtime support and more memory. The Finder uses a 32,000-token default planning ceiling for this native profile. Longer contexts need a separately configured runtime. See [[guides/context-length|context length]].

## What if it loads but runs out of memory?

Close other GPU workloads and reduce context. If needed, use a smaller file or partial CPU offload. For Macs or CPU-only setups, select the appropriate mode in the Finder; installed RAM is not dedicated VRAM.

## Why does the exact RTX 3080 variant matter?

NVIDIA lists **10 GB and 12 GB RTX 3080 variants**. This page uses 10 GB. A recommendation calculated for the 12 GB version can exceed this card’s budget; select the exact model in the Finder.

## Should I try a 14B model?

At the Q4 and 4K settings shown, the reviewed 14B profiles exceed this full-GPU budget. Start with the listed smaller models. More GPU compute does not make weights and cache fit into less VRAM.

## Can I increase Q4 to Q5?

Check the exact model’s Q5 profile in the Finder first, keeping context fixed. It uses more weight memory and reduces headroom. Compare answers on your own task; higher precision does not guarantee a useful improvement, and this page does not establish inference speed.

## Why does the exact RTX 3080 variant matter?

NVIDIA lists **10 GB and 12 GB RTX 3080 variants**. This page uses 10 GB. A recommendation calculated for the 12 GB version can exceed this card’s budget; select the exact model in the Finder.

## Should I try a 14B model?

At Q4 and 4K, Qwen3 14B exceeds this FP16-cache budget. The 14B Coder is a tight planning fit, with less than 0.5 GiB left after the reserve; its cache precision is not verified. Start with a smaller model and check the runtime’s reported allocation before trying it.

## Can I increase Q4 to Q5?

Check the exact model’s Q5 profile in the Finder first, keeping context fixed. It uses more weight memory and reduces headroom. Compare answers on your own task; higher precision does not guarantee a useful improvement, and this page does not establish inference speed.
